reviews.name: JATIN MITTAL
reviews.title: Software Engineer - 2
reviews.review: Good idea. When someone has just lost a job, even reaching out can feel hard. A clear way to ask for help could make a real difference.

reviews.name: Anurag Singh
reviews.title: Software Engineer
reviews.review: I like that this gives people a better way to ask for a referral. You can share the job you want instead of sending the same message to everyone.

reviews.name: Gayatri Batta
reviews.title: Gen AI Engineer
reviews.review: This feels useful for both sides. If I know which job someone wants and why, I can decide whether I'm the right person to help.

reviews.name: Anuj Sharma
reviews.title: SDE-2
reviews.review: Good initiative, especially for people affected by the layoffs. It helps to know where to start when you're looking for your next role.

reviews.name: Nitesh A
reviews.title: Software Engineer - 2
reviews.review: I appreciate the idea of being able to track a request. Not knowing whether anyone has seen it is the hardest part of asking.

reviews.name: VIPIN SINGH
reviews.review: Helping someone find the right person for a referral is a good start. A simple request with the job details makes it easier to help.

reviews.name: Aditya Dubey
reviews.title: Business Associate
reviews.review: Looking for a business analytics role can be a lot of work. A simple way to share my background and the job I want would make asking for a referral easier.
